entities.summary: Douglas Scott Wreden, better known as DougDoug, is an American YouTuber, Twitch streamer, podcaster, author, speedrunner and former Hearthstone caster and producer. He makes gaming videos that revolve around him doing various gaming challenges, often involving the use of artificial intelligence, modifications to games, and giving his viewers on Twitch heavy control of the game or stream. He retired his main YouTube channel in late 2025.
